description: JSON read variant coverage matrix over the shared mount fixture (mount-fixture-manifest.json), the cross-language contract for EndoMount.readJson / maybeReadJson. Each case is { name, method: 'readJson' | 'maybeReadJson', path, ...outcome } where `path` is a mount-face-relative path and exactly one outcome key is set: `expect` (the exact JSON value the parse yields — asserted by deep equality), `expectUndefined: true` (the call resolves to undefined, only valid for maybeReadJson on a missing/escaping path), or `expectThrows: true` (the call rejects — a missing file for readJson, or invalid JSON in a present file for either method, since the parse sits outside maybeReadJson's read guard). The write side (writeJson round trip, 2-space + trailing-newline formatting, the non-serializable throw) is stateful and lives in the Node unit tests in mount-json.test.js, not in this cross-language read table. The Node runner is mount-json.test.js; a Rust/XS-side runner consumes this same JSON to assert identical results.

cases.name: readJson of the fixture data.json (nested-value fidelity)
maybeReadJson of an existing file returns the parsed value
maybeReadJson of a missing file is undefined
readJson of a missing file throws
readJson of a present file with invalid JSON throws
maybeReadJson of a present file with invalid JSON still throws (parse outside the read guard)
